visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: A LinkedList Class Instead of Hand-Linked Nodes
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Three nodes are created and linked field by field in main. Write a small list class with an addLast method and a printAll method that prints each value on its own line. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The list class hides the pointer handling behind two clear operations, so callers cannot link nodes wrongly, and adding a fourth value is one more call.
